Шанс, что вместо одного Sea Creature клю: The chance that two Sea Creatures bite instead of one. Twice the Fishing XP, drops and bestiary kills per cast.
Посмотри текущее значение: SkyBlock Menu: Check the current value: SkyBlock Menu → Your SkyBlock Profile, the Double Hook Chance stat.
Подними его Titan Line (+2) у Roddy, рео: Raise it with the Titan Line (+2) from Roddy, rod reforges and gear with this stat.
Светящееся пятно с частицами на воде или: A glowing patch with particles on water or lava. It lives a few minutes, then appears elsewhere. While the bobber is inside, the patch's bonus applies (Fishing Speed, Sea Creature Chance, Treasure Chance or Trophy Chance) and special Hotspot creatures bite.
Ищи частицы над водой: Backwater Bayou,: Look for particles above the water: Backwater Bayou, Spider's Den, Crimson Isle (lava) and other islands.
Закидывай поплавок прямо в круг — бонус: Cast the bobber right into the circle: the bonus only works while the bobber is inside.
Hotspot Hook, Hotspot Sinker и Hotspot B: Hotspot Hook, Hotspot Sinker and Hotspot Bait boost the patch and its creature chance.
Шанс, что вместо обычной рыбы клюнет Sea: The chance that a Sea Creature bites instead of a normal fish. Creatures give almost all Fishing XP, drops and bestiary progress, so it's the main fishing stat.
Даёт удочка (Rod of the Sea, Hellfire Ro: Comes from the rod (Rod of the Sea, Hellfire Rod), fishing armor, pets (Flying Fish, Ammonite, Megalodon), the Sea Creature Talisman/Ring/Artifact and the Fishing potion.
Шанс поймать Trophy Fish при рыбалке в л: The chance to catch a Trophy Fish when fishing in Crimson Isle lava. The higher it is, the faster you complete species and tiers for Odger's rewards.
Даёт лавовая удочка (Magma → Inferno → H: Comes from a lava rod (Magma → Inferno → Hellfire Rod), Trophy Line and Hot Bait.
Насколько быстрее клюёт. Больше забросов: How much faster fish bite. More casts per minute means more creatures and XP.
Даёт Speedy Line, снаряжение Ichthyic/Fi: Comes from the Speedy Line, Ichthyic/Finwave/Gillsplash gear, the Lure enchant and pets.
Шанс выловить сокровище (предметы и моне: The chance to fish up a treasure (items and coins) instead of a fish. Barely matters for XP farming.
18 видов особой рыбы, которая ловится то: 18 special fish species caught only in Crimson Isle lava. Each species has 4 tiers: bronze, silver, gold and diamond. Odger gives Trophy Fisher rewards for collected species.
Возьми лавовую удочку и рыбачь в лаве Cr: Take a lava rod and fish in Crimson Isle lava.
Для редких видов выполни условие: место,: For rare species meet the condition: place, time, bait or casting method (listed in the guide's table).
Пойманную рыбу неси Odger на вершине Bla: Bring caught fish to Odger at the top of the Blazing Volcano: he counts species and fillets the extras into Magmafish.
100-й улов одного вида Trophy Fish гаран: The 100th catch of one Trophy Fish species is guaranteed gold, the 600th diamond, if you don't have that tier yet. The counter is all catches of that species ever.
Зачарование удочки: +2% за уровень к шан: A rod enchant: +2% per level to the silver, gold and diamond chance of Trophy Fish (Charm V: diamond 0.2% → 0.22%). Doesn't affect the chance to catch a trophy itself.
Книги Charm I–V — с рыбалки и на Bazaar,: Charm I–V books come from fishing and the Bazaar, Charm VI from the Chain of the End Times. Needs Enchanting 25.
Бонус от 2 надетых частей Hunter Armor:: The bonus for 2 equipped Hunter Armor pieces: Sea Creatures no longer bite or hit you, but you can't hit them either. Good for pure trophy hunting, bad for Fishing XP.
Бонус Hunter Armor к Trophy Fish Chance: Hunter Armor's Trophy Fish Chance bonus for 2/3/4 pieces: Bronze 3/4/5, Silver 5/7.5/10, Gold 10/15/20, Diamond 20/25/30.
Ранги Odger за Trophy Fish. Novice — 15: Odger's ranks for Trophy Fish. Novice is 15 species at bronze, Adept silver on all 18, Expert gold on all 18, Master all tiers on all 18. Novice unlocks Thunder, Adept Lord Jawbus.
Поговори с Odger на вершине Blazing Volc: Talk to Odger at the top of the Blazing Volcano (Crimson Isle) and claim the reward in his menu: meeting the condition alone unlocks nothing.
Расходник для рыбалки: лежит в инвентаре: A fishing consumable: kept in your inventory or Fishing Bag, one is used per cast. Each bait gives its own bonus: more creatures, shark chance, trophies, night creatures and so on.
Покупается у Fishing Merchant в Hub и у: Sold by the Fishing Merchant in the Hub and by Roddy, some are crafted. The Stingy Sinker saves bait.
Счётчик убийств каждого вида мобов. За у: A kill counter for each mob type. Bestiary levels give permanent stats and SkyBlock XP, and for Sea Creatures also a Sea Creature Chance bonus for that creature.
Прогресс виден в SkyBlock Menu → Your Sk: Progress is in SkyBlock Menu → Your SkyBlock Profile → Bestiary. For Sea Creatures, just catch them the required number of times.
Mobs that sometimes bite instead of a fish. They have to be killed. They give most Fishing XP, drops (materials for armor and rods) and bestiary. New kinds unlock with Fishing level.
Рыболовный фестиваль: первые 3 дня каждо: Fishing Festival: the first 3 days of each SkyBlock month when Marina is mayor (or her perk is active). Sharks bite in any water: Nurse (5), Blue (10), Tiger (18), Great White (24).
Check the mayor in the Hub (Election building).
Бери Shark Bait (+20% шанс акул) и рыбач: Take Shark Bait (+20% shark chance) and fish in any water.
Зубы и плавники акул продаются, из Shark: Shark teeth and fins sell, and Shark Fins make Shark Scale Armor.
Хэллоуин SkyBlock: дни 29–31 месяца Autu: SkyBlock Halloween: days 29–31 of the Autumn month. Spooky creatures bite in any water: Scarecrow, Nightmare, Werewolf, Phantom Fisher, Grim Reaper.
Бери Spooky Bait и Spooky Hook, рыбачь в: Take Spooky Bait and a Spooky Hook and fish in any water, ideally at night.
Зимний остров. Открыт только в месяц Lat: The winter island. Open only in the Late Winter month. Winter creatures bite there (Frozen Steve, Frosty, Grinch, Yeti, Reindrake), and Ice Bait and Frozen Bait only work here.
Дождись Late Winter, зайди через портал: Wait for Late Winter, enter through the portal in the Hub or /warp winter.
Зимнее событие в Jerry's Workshop (дни 2: A winter event in Jerry's Workshop (days 24–26 of Late Winter): island defense, gifts and North Stars.
Шанс ударить ещё раз сразу же: 50 Feroci: The chance to strike again right away: 50 Ferocity is a 50% chance of a second hit, 100 always gives a second hit, above 100 a chance at a third. Useful against creatures and high-HP mobs.
Повышает шанс редких дропов с мобов (не: Raises the chance of rare drops from mobs (not from dungeon chests). 100 Magic Find = rare drops twice as often.
Бонус полного сета брони Wither (Necron': The full Wither armor set bonus (Necron's, Storm's, Goldor's, Maxor's, Wither). Every few seconds it releases skeleton skulls that hit mobs, and gives Wither stats. Wither families can be mixed: the bonus is shared.
Части падают из сундуков F7/M7, улучшают: Pieces drop from F7/M7 chests and are upgraded with Wither essence stars.
The top dungeon run score: 300+ points. Points come from skill (no deaths), speed, secrets found and mobs killed (Exploration). S+ gives more Catacombs XP and better chest loot.
Не умирай: каждая смерть −2 очка (первая: Don't die: each death is −2 points (the first one with a Spirit pet is free).
Ищи секреты в комнатах: моды вроде Skyti: Look for secrets in rooms: mods like Skytils/SkyHanni highlight them.
Чисти комнаты до конца и не затягивай за: Clear rooms fully and don't drag the run out.
Усложнённые этажи M1–M7: мобы и боссы на: Harder floors M1–M7: mobs and bosses are much stronger, but there's more Catacombs XP and loot, and Master Stars drop from M3. Each M floor unlocks with a win on the previous one (M1 after F7) and a Catacombs level.
В Dungeon Hub выбери в Party Finder или: In the Dungeon Hub pick Master Mode in the Party Finder or at Mort.
Звёзды 6–10 для данж-предметов (после пя: Stars 6–10 for dungeon items (after the five normal essence stars). Each gives even more stats. The First–Fifth Master Stars drop on M3–M7.
Шкала гарантированного дропа: выбери ред: A guaranteed drop bar: pick a rare item, and each run/boss adds points. When it fills, the item is guaranteed to drop. Slayers and each dungeon floor have their own meter.
Открывается кликом по Catacombs-сундуку: Opened by clicking a Catacombs chest or at Maddox (slayers): pick a goal and just farm.
Спрятанные сундуки, предметы, летучие мы: Hidden chests, items, bats and levers in rooms. They give Exploration points for S+ and useful loot; the total number of secrets affects some items.
Уровень данжей (1–50). Растёт за победы: Dungeon level (1–50). Grows with floor wins; unlocks new floors and Master Mode, and boosts dungeon items inside the dungeon.
В данже выбирается класс: Archer, Berser: In a dungeon you pick a class: Archer, Berserk, Mage, Healer, Tank. Only the selected one gets full XP, the others 25%.
Материал для звёзд на данж- и Kuudra-пре: The material for stars on dungeon and Kuudra items. Types: Wither, Undead, Dragon, Gold, Diamond, Ice, Spider, Crimson. Drops from dungeon and Kuudra chests, and also from salvaging items.
Звёзды ставятся в Dungeon Hub → Malik ил: Stars are applied in the Dungeon Hub → Malik, or in the Essence Shop/Anvil menu.
Защита от истинного урона (True Damage),: Protection against True Damage, which ignores normal Defense. Needed against Sven Packmaster and Inferno Demonlord.
Урон, который игнорирует обычную Defense: Damage that ignores normal Defense. Only True Defense reduces it.
Щит Voidgloom Seraph снимается числом уд: Voidgloom Seraph's shield is removed by number of hits, not damage: while it's up, almost no damage gets through. So fast weapons (Terminator, Atomsplit Katana) break it best.
С T2 у Inferno Demonlord щит одного из ч: From T2 the Inferno Demonlord has a shield in one of four colors (Ashen, Spirit, Crystal, Auric). Damage is cut by 99% if the dagger's attunement doesn't match. The shield changes every 8 hits.
Держи в руке кинжал блейз-слеера (Firedu: Hold a Blaze Slayer dagger (Firedust/Twilight and up).
Смотри на цвет щита и ПКМ кинжалом, пока: Watch the shield color and right-click the dagger until the attunement color matches.
Уровень слеера растёт за убитых боссов э: Slayer level grows with kills of that boss type (quests from Maddox the Slayer). Levels unlock recipes, the Batphone, new tiers and give permanent stats. "Wolf Slayer 3" means wolf slayer level 3 (Sven Packmaster).
Каждый убитый босс даёт опыт своего слее: Each boss kill gives XP for its slayer (T1 5, T2 25, T3 100, T4 500, T5 1500). Slayer levels unlock recipes and give permanent stats.
Мэр с перками для слееров: Slayer XP Buf: A mayor with slayer perks: Slayer XP Buff (+25% Slayer XP), Pathfinder (rare drop chance) and cheaper quests. When he's mayor it's the best time to level slayers.
Проверить мэра: здание Election в Hub ил: Check the mayor: the Election building in the Hub or /calendar.
Мэр рыбаков: Fishing Festival каждый мес: The fishermen's mayor: a Fishing Festival every month, more Sea Creature Chance and Fishing Speed.
Предмет-телефон: звонит Maddox и открыва: A phone item: calls Maddox and opens the slayer menu anywhere. The recipe unlocks at Wolf Slayer 3.
Телепорт на блок, на который смотришь (п: Teleport to the block you're looking at (crouch + right-click an Aspect of the Void with an Etherwarp Conduit). The main way to move quickly through a dungeon.
Поиск группы в Dungeon Hub и на Crimson: Group search in the Dungeon Hub and on Crimson Isle: you pick a floor/tier, class and requirements, and players join by themselves.
Предмет привязан к профилю: его нельзя п: The item is bound to the profile: it can't be sold on the auction house or given to another player.
Ключ от платного сундука после победы на: The key to the paid chest after beating Kuudra. One per tier, crafted from coins and faction materials, Soulbound.
Очки фракции Crimson Isle (Mages или Bar: Crimson Isle faction points (Mages or Barbarians). They grow with daily faction quests, minibosses, Dojo and Kuudra. They unlock Kuudra tiers and faction shops.
Каждый день бери 5 квестов на доске в го: Every day take 5 quests from the board in your faction's town (Dragontail for Barbarians, Scarleton for Mages).
Арена на Crimson Isle с семью испытаниям: An arena on Crimson Isle with seven tests (Force, Stamina, Mastery, Discipline, Swiftness, Control, Tenacity). Rank F to S by points; Master Tao gives belts for the total score.
Зайди с пустым инвентарём и без питомца,: Enter with an empty inventory and no pet, right-click Master Tao and pick a test.
A creature deep in the Crimson Isle volcano. It gives 3 Heavy Pearls per real day, needed for Kuudra armor stars.
Редкий мини-иссушитель Crimson Isle (10: A rare mini-wither on Crimson Isle (10M health): can spawn after killing any mob on the island. It drops a Nether Star, which the Emissary trades for a Kuudra Key.
Дерево перков добычи (уровни 1–10). Опыт: The mining perk tree (levels 1–10). HotM XP comes from commissions in the Dwarven Mines/Crystal Hollows and mining; each level gives perk tokens, and perks are leveled with Powder.
Открой меню: SkyBlock Menu → Heart of th: Open the menu: SkyBlock Menu → Heart of the Mountain (or /hotm).
Валюта перков HotM. Mithril Powder — Dwa: The HotM perk currency. Mithril Powder from the Dwarven Mines, Gemstone Powder from the Crystal Hollows (gems, chests), Glacite Powder from the Glacite Tunnels and Mineshafts.
Forge в Dwarven Mines: превращает матери: The Forge in the Dwarven Mines: turns materials into items over real time (hours). The higher your HotM, the more slots. Good passive money.
/warp forge, ПКМ по Forge, положи матери: /warp forge, right-click the Forge, put in the recipe materials, come back when the timer ends.
Центр Crystal Hollows. Поставь в него 5: The center of the Crystal Hollows. Place 5 crystals in it (Jade, Amber, Amethyst, Sapphire, Topaz) and a chest with Divan parts, gems and Powder opens.
Добудь все 5 кристаллов в разных зонах C: Get all 5 crystals in different Crystal Hollows zones (see the guide's checklist).
Принеси их в центр пещер и поставь на по: Bring them to the center of the caves and place them on the pedestals.
Случайные шахты, которые иногда открываю: Random shafts that sometimes open while mining in the Glacite Tunnels. Inside are Frozen Corpses with loot and gems. The chance grows with the Surveyor perk.
Замёрзшие трупы гномов в Mineshafts. Lap: Frozen dwarf corpses in Mineshafts. Lapis opens right away, Umber, Tungsten and Vanguard with keys. They give Dwarven Handwarmers materials, armor and Glacite Powder.
Шанс, что при добыче гема выпадет сразу: The chance that mining a gem drops the Flawless version right away. The main stat for gem money.
Сколько лишних блоков падает с каждой до: How many extra blocks drop per break: 100 Fortune = twice the drops.
Mining Speed: чем выше, тем быстрее лома: Mining Speed: the higher it is, the faster ores, gems and stone break.
Дерево перков Foraging на Galatea (уровн: The Foraging perk tree on Galatea (levels 1–8). XP comes from Hina's tasks and chopping trees; perks are leveled with Whispers.
Валюта перков Heart of the Forest: падае: The Heart of the Forest perk currency: drops from Tree Gifts on Galatea.
Подарок за полностью срубленное дерево н: A gift for a fully felled tree on Galatea: loot and Whispers.
Сколько брёвен ломается одним ударом топ: How many logs break with one axe hit. The main Foraging speed stat.
Сколько лишнего урожая падает с каждого: How much extra crop drops per block: 100 Fortune = twice as much. The main farming stat.
Валюта Garden. Её дают Visitors за выпол: The Garden currency. Visitors give it for completed orders. Spent on Crop Upgrades, tools and SkyMart items.
NPC, которые сами приходят в Garden (до: NPCs who come to the Garden by themselves (up to 5 in the queue) and ask for some crops. An order gives Copper, Garden XP and sometimes a rare drop.
Visit the Garden and fill orders at the Desk. Decline if an order costs more than the reward.
Улучшения культур в Garden за Copper: +5: Garden crop upgrades for Copper: +5 Farming Fortune to that crop per level, max 9.
In the Garden: Desk → Crop Upgrades.
Машина в Garden: из органики и топлива с: A Garden machine that makes Compost from organic matter and fuel by itself. Compost is needed for new plots and sells on the Bazaar.
Мелкие мобы, которые появляются на участ: Small mobs that spawn on Garden plots while farming and slow growth. Kill them with a vacuum: they drop Pest items, and Pests themselves trade at Pesthunter Phillip.
Фермерский конкурс каждый час: 3 культур: A farming contest every hour: 3 crops, whoever harvests the most wins. Medals (bronze/silver/gold) and Jacob's Tickets.
Когда начнётся — фарми одну из трёх куль: When it starts, farm one of the three crops for 20 minutes.
Награду забери у Jacob в Hub (Farm) или: Claim the reward from Jacob in the Hub (Farm) or in the Garden.
Таймер в Рифте: тикает каждую секунду, н: The Rift timer: ticks every second, and at zero you're kicked out. Enigma Souls, timecharms and Rift items raise the maximum.
Валюта Рифта: за мобов, продажу Рифт-пре: The Rift currency: from mobs, selling Rift items and tasks. Spent only in the Rift.
52 спрятанные души в Рифте. Каждая с Eni: 52 hidden souls in the Rift. Each gives +20 s of Rift Time with the Enigma Cloak.
8 главных трофеев Рифта. Ставятся в гале: The Rift's 8 main trophies. Placed in Elise's gallery, they unlock zones and boost the Rift Necklace.
Каждый новый уровень каждого миньона, ск: Each new tier of each minion, crafted for the first time, counts once. The more unique crafts, the more minion slots on your island.
Биржа ресурсов: мгновенная покупка/прода: The resource exchange: instant buy/sell or orders at your own price. /bz with a Booster Cookie, otherwise the Bazaar NPC in the Hub.
Buy It Now — лот на аукционе с фиксирова: Buy It Now: an auction lot with a fixed price, bought instantly. "Lowest BIN" is the cheapest such lot.
Общий уровень профиля: растёт почти за в: The overall profile level: grows from almost everything (skills, collections, bestiary, slayers). Unlocks features and gives stats.
Печенье на 4 дня: /bz и /ah откуда угодн: A 4-day cookie: /bz and /ah from anywhere, Bits, more XP and Magic Find, items aren't lost on death.
Приставка к предмету с бонусом статов. Д: A prefix on an item with bonus stats. Done at the Blacksmith in the Hub for coins, or with a Reforge Stone at the Reforge Anvil.
Навык рыбалки. В таблицах — уровень Fish: The fishing skill. In tables, the Fishing level at which an item or creature unlocks.
Навык добычи. Растёт за руды, гемы и кам: The mining skill. Grows from ores, gems and stone.
Навык рубки деревьев: даёт силу и SkyBlo: The tree chopping skill: gives Strength and SkyBlock XP.
Навык фермерства. Кап поднимается до 60: The farming skill. The cap is raised to 60 at Anita for Jacob's Contest medals.
Навык боя: растёт за убийства мобов, нуж: The combat skill: grows from mob kills, needed for Kuudra armor and many items.
Здание в Hub, куда жертвуют предметы и с: A building in the Hub where items and armor sets are donated. Each donated item gives SkyBlock XP forever, and every 100 museum XP is a milestone with a reward.
Иди в Hub (/hub) к Madame Eleanor Q. Gol: Go to the Hub (/hub) to Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth III.
В меню Your Museum кликни по предмету в: In the Your Museum menu click an item in your inventory → Confirm Donation.
Каждые 100 SkyBlock XP, полученных за му: Every 100 SkyBlock XP earned from the museum is a new milestone (40 total). Milestones give +1% Bits Multiplier, +2% Bank Interest and their own rewards (milestone 3: Museum Appraisal and Deluxe Bank Upgrade).
Награды забираются в меню Museum Milesto: Rewards are claimed in the Museum Milestones menu in the museum.
Предмет привязан к острову: его нельзя п: The item is bound to the island: it can't be sold on the auction house or passed outside the co-op. Any item donated to the museum becomes Co-op Soulbound, even if you take it back later.
Пожертвованный предмет можно забрать из: A donated item can be taken out of the museum by clicking it. Its SkyBlock XP stays, and you can put it back on display any time.
Разовая услуга за 10 млн, открывается на: A one-time 10M service, unlocked at milestone 3: an appraisal of the museum's value. Afterwards the value shows in your profile and on stats sites. Doesn't affect progress.
Отдельная страница музея для редких и со: A separate museum page for rare and event items. They give no SkyBlock XP and don't count toward section percentages, but they grow the collection and the museum appraisal.
Настройка Hypixel, разрешающая сайтам ви: A Hypixel setting that lets sites see your museum. Without it, donations aren't visible.
Множитель Bits, которые даёт Booster Coo: The multiplier for Bits from the Booster Cookie. Each museum milestone adds +1%.
Проценты, которые Bank начисляет на вкла: The interest the Bank pays on deposits every season. Museum milestones add +2% to it.
Главный остров с NPC, аукционом, Bazaar: The main island with NPCs, the auction house, the Bazaar and portals to other islands.
Остров рыбаков: Roddy ставит детали удоч: The fishermen's island: Roddy fits rod parts, Junker Joel trades Rusty Coins for Backwater Armor, with its own creatures (Titanoboa, Alligator) and Hotspots.
Огненный остров: фракции Mages/Barbarian: The fire island: the Mages/Barbarians factions, Kuudra, Inferno Demonlord, lava fishing and trophy fish.
Вулкан в центре Crimson Isle: на вершине: The volcano in the center of Crimson Isle: Odger at the top, geysers and lava ponds for trophy fish around it.
Болото на Crimson Isle (к юго-западу от: A swamp on Crimson Isle (southwest of the volcano). Moldfin is caught here.
Город Mages на Crimson Isle. Лава здесь: The Mages' town on Crimson Isle. Lava here counts as part of the Mystic Marsh: Moldfin bites.
Город Barbarians на Crimson Isle. Лава з: The Barbarians' town on Crimson Isle. Lava here counts as part of the Burning Desert: Skeleton Fish bites.
Места в лаве у вулкана, над которыми под: Spots in the lava by the volcano with white particles rising above them. A bobber within 2 blocks of a geyser is the condition for the Steaming-Hot Flounder.
Пустыня на востоке Crimson Isle. Здесь л: A desert in the east of Crimson Isle. Skeleton Fish is caught here.
Крепость на Crimson Isle: блейз-слеер и: A fortress on Crimson Isle: Blaze Slayer and Soul Fish.
Додзё у города Barbarians на Crimson Isl: The dojo near the Barbarians' town on Crimson Isle: tests for reputation; Karate Fish is caught in its lava.
Гробница на Crimson Isle: демоны для кве: A tomb on Crimson Isle: demons for Inferno Demonlord quests.
A huge gem cave under the Dwarven Mines. Needs a pass (Crystal Hollows Pass) from Gwendolyn. Zones: Mines of Divan, Goblin Holdout, Jungle, Precursor Remnants, Magma Fields.
Шахты гномов: Mithril, Titanium, задания: The dwarven mines: Mithril, Titanium, commissions, The Forge.
Ледяные туннели под Dwarven Base Camp: U: Ice tunnels below the Dwarven Base Camp: Umber, Tungsten, Glacite and new gems, the Mineshaft entrance.
Зона Crystal Hollows: сундуки с Divan Fr: A Crystal Hollows zone: chests with Divan Fragments, the Jade crystal.
Зона гоблинов в Crystal Hollows: Goblin: The goblin zone in the Crystal Hollows: the Goblin Queen and the Amber crystal.
Руины в Crystal Hollows: Professor Robot: Ruins in the Crystal Hollows: Professor Robot and the Sapphire crystal.
Нижняя зона Crystal Hollows: жарко, босс: The lower Crystal Hollows zone: hot, the Bal boss and the Topaz crystal.
Кладбище в Хабе: зомби и квесты Revenant: The graveyard in the Hub: zombies and Revenant Horror quests.
Остров пауков: Tarantula Broodfather, Ar: The spider island: Tarantula Broodfather, Arachne. Also the portal to Crimson Isle.
Энд: эндермены, Voidgloom Seraph, дракон: The End: endermen, Voidgloom Seraph, dragons.
Лесной остров с деревьями и волками (How: A forest island with trees and wolves (Howling Cave: Sven Packmaster).
Новый остров Foraging: Fig, Mangrove и H: The new Foraging island: Fig, Mangrove and Helix, Hina, Heart of the Forest.
Личный фермерский остров: участки, гости: Your personal farming island: plots, visitors, the Composter, Crop Upgrades.
Пустыня на Farming Islands: Trevor, Oasi: A desert on the Farming Islands: Trevor, the Oasis (water with Oasis creatures).
Хаб данжей: вход в Catacombs, Party Find: The dungeon hub: the Catacombs entrance, Party Finder, Malik (stars) and essence shops.
The wizard's tower in the Hub: the Rift entrance.
The vampire castle in the Rift: Vampire Slayer.
Домик рыбака у озера в Хабе: Fishing Mer: The fisherman's hut by the Hub lake: the Fishing Merchant sells bait and Angler Armor.
Особый лавовый пруд на Crimson Isle (за: A special lava pond on Crimson Isle (behind the Blazing Volcano waterfall) where Plhlegblast is caught.
На Crimson Isle две фракции: Mages (горо: Crimson Isle has two factions: Mages (Scarleton) and Barbarians (Dragontail). You pick one; its quests and shop give reputation, armor and access to Kuudra.
Упавшая звезда в Dwarven Mines: появляет: A fallen star in the Dwarven Mines: it appears from time to time and players mine it together for Starfall and Mithril Powder.
Машина в Tangleburg (Galatea): из двух ш: A machine in Tangleburg (Galatea): turns two shards into a new one. This is how you get shards that can't be caught by hunting.
Главное меню игры: звезда Nether Star в: The main game menu: the Nether Star in the last inventory slot or the /sbmenu command. Skills, collections, Settings and other sections open from here.
Стол в Barn в Garden: главное меню Garde: The desk in the Barn on the Garden: the main Garden menu. Crop Upgrades, Plots, Garden Level, Crop Milestones and the Composter open from here.
/warp garden, подойди к столу в Barn и н: /warp garden, walk up to the desk in the Barn and right-click it.
Магазин в Garden за Copper: инструменты: The Garden shop for Copper: farming tools, upgrades and Garden items.
Участки Garden вокруг Barn: всего 24. От: Garden plots around the Barn: 24 in total. Unlocked with Compost in Desk → Configure Plots; each can grow its own crop.
Шкала гарантированного дропа: выбери ред: Guaranteed-drop meter: pick a rare item and every run/boss adds XP. When it fills, the item drops for sure. Slayers, every dungeon floor and Mineshaft corpses have their own meter.
Открывается кликом по Catacombs-сундуку,: Opened by clicking a Catacombs chest, at Maddox (slayers) or at Grandpa Wolf (/corpsemilestones): pick a target and just farm.
Замёрзшие трупы гномов в Mineshafts. Lap: Frozen dwarf corpses in Mineshafts. Lapis opens right away, Umber and Tungsten with their own key, Vanguard (only in the Fairy shaft) with a Skeleton Key. They give gemstones, Plates, keys, Glacite Powder and HotM XP.
7 вех за открытые трупы в Mineshafts. На: 7 milestones for corpses opened in Mineshafts. Rewards: Organ Donor Talisman → Ring → Artifact, +10% chance of an extra corpse and an extra item, Glacite Powder and RNG Meter XP. Earlier corpses count.
Поговори с Grandpa Wolf в его пещере в G: Talk to Grandpa Wolf in his cave in the Glacite Tunnels (-56 125 332).
Дальше меню открывается командой /corpse: After that the menu opens with /corpsemilestones.
Награду за каждую веху забирай в меню са: Claim each milestone reward in the menu yourself.
NPC в Grandpa Wolf’s Cave в Glacite Tunn: NPC in Grandpa Wolf’s Cave in the Glacite Tunnels (-56 125 332). Unlocks Frozen Corpse Milestones and the corpse RNG Meter; his cave is not cold.
Kill counter for every mob family. A family tier gives +3 Magic Find and +3 Strength against it, and every 10 tiers is a milestone: +1 Health and Combat XP.
Счёт включает Bramass Beastslayer в Spid: Bramass Beastslayer in the Spider's Den turns counting on. Progress: SkyBlock Menu → Your Skills → Combat → Bestiary. Sea Creatures count for whoever caught them.
